description: This file defines the Catalyst controller for managing organizations within the Coocook application. It includes actions for creating, viewing, updating, deleting, and leaving organizations, with associated permission checks and related data handling.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Organization
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing organization-related actions within the Coocook application.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new organization, validating input, checking name availability, and redirecting upon success.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures the organization by name from the URL and sets it in the stash, redirecting if not found.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays details of an organization, including users and projects, with permission checks.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates organization details such as description and display name.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the organization and redirects to the appropriate page.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Allows a user to leave an organization.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Private method to redirect to the organization's show page.
